package.description: Easy-to-use 2D/3D electrical CAD software for creating electrical schematics and wiring

en-GB.description: Easy-to-use 2D/3D electrical CAD software for creating electrical schematics and wiring
en-GB.longDescription: SEE Electrical is an easy-to-use Electrical CAD software to efficiently create electrical schematics and wiring. With SEE Electrical, you can quickly produce conceptual diagrams and generate assembly drawings, strips, and cable lists. This intuitive electrical CAD software enables electrical professionals to efficiently create, document, and optimize electrical schematics, improving productivity, design efficiency, and accuracy in every project. This popular software allows you to efficiently draw electrical and automation diagrams, including single-line and multi-line diagrams. The program saves you time from the very beginning of design and is truly a dedicated electrical design tool. All functions of the SEE Electrical diagram software are easy to use and tailored to electrical projects, featuring ANSI and IEC symbol libraries and electrical equipment catalogues. After creating diagrams, you can generate automatic reports, such as basic BOMs, lists of devices, terminal strips, cables overviews, connectivity and more. The included manufacturer equipment catalog and NFPA can be expanded manually or by importing data from Excel, XML, or ETAP data's portal. Extensive libraries of symbols are available with names consistent with their applications, allowing users to easily create additional symbols as needed. This electrical CAD software can also be expanded with additional modules, such as SEE Electrical 3D Panel.
en-GB.name: SEE Electrical

zh-CN.description: 用于 2D 和 3D 电气设计的电气 CAD 软件
zh-CN.longDescription: SEE Electrical 是一款易于使用的电气 CAD 软件，可高效创建电气原理图和接线。SEE Electrical 订阅根据您的需求提供启动、增长和扩展选项。您可以选择最适合您需求的套餐，或先访问我们的 30 天免费试用版。这款直观的电气 CAD 软件使电气专业人员能够高效地创建、记录和优化电气原理图，从而提高每个项目的生产力、设计效率和准确性。这款流行的软件可以让您高效地绘制电气和自动化图表，包括单线和多线图。该程序从设计一开始就节省您的时间：它确实是一个电气设计程序。SEE Electrical 图表软件的所有功能均易于使用且专用于电气项目：IEC 符号库、电气设备目录。创建图表后，您可以制作自动报告，例如基本BOM、设备列表和文档列表。制造商设备的包含目录可以手动扩展，也可以通过从 Excel、XML 和 ECAD 导入来扩展。提供丰富的符号库，其名称与其应用程序一致，允许用户根据需要轻松创建其他符号。该电气 CAD 可通过附加模块进行扩展，例如 SEE Web Catalogue。
